column4: cleat#3245 Phase 3 step 2 piece 3: all three tests open a *PostgresStore directly via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) (heartbeatLeaseTestStore), which skips on CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES alone regardless of what else is set -- workflow_leases is PostgreSQL-only (the issue's own scoping decision, same as piece 2's claim/release tests), so these three have no MySQL or MSSQL form to run instead. multi-db/mysql sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all three skip here. 3 skips, not a subtest group -- same shape as claim-and-release-update-the-lease-row.tsv's three.
same three tests, same reason: multi-db/mssql sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all three skip here too -- see the multi-db/mysql line above.
